governance_invariants: Prediction support flags do not remove or reject rows automatically.
Expected, predictive, linear, and duration-median quantities remain distinct.
Predictions are descriptive posterior quantities and do not establish causal effects.
Prediction does not establish out-of-sample adequacy.
No fitting or posterior mutation occurs during prediction.
Binary predictive draws are Bernoulli; duration predictive draws are lognormal.
Duration expected values include the lognormal residual-scale correction.
intentional_python_adaptations: PyMC InferenceData replaces brms posterior containers.
The Python implementation reconstructs approved linear predictors from retained posterior draws instead of calling brms posterior_epred/posterior_predict/posterior_linpred.
Python mappings replace R named lists in create_prediction_grid(at=...).
New grouping levels with allow_new_levels=True use posterior-draw uncertainty from fitted group effects; they are never accepted silently when allow_new_levels=False.
